test_cases.question: How is the Chair of the European Data Protection Board elected?
test_cases.answer: The Board shall elect a chair and two deputy chairs from amongst its members by simple majority. This means only existing Board members are eligible, and election requires more than half of members to agree.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Board shall elect a chair and two deputy chairs from amongst its members by simple majority

test_cases.question: How long is the term of office for the EDPB Chair and deputy chairs?
test_cases.answer: The term of office of the Chair and of the deputy chairs shall be five years and be renewable once. This means a Chair could serve a maximum of 10 years total (two five-year terms).
test_cases.supporting_quote: The term of office of the Chair and of the deputy chairs shall be five years and be renewable once

test_cases.question: How many leadership positions are elected for the Board?
test_cases.answer: Three leadership positions are elected: one Chair and two deputy chairs. All must be elected from amongst existing Board members by simple majority vote.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Board shall elect a chair and two deputy chairs from amongst its members

coverage.73(1): Test cases 1 and 3 - Election process, eligibility, voting threshold, number of positions
coverage.73(2): Test case 2 - Five-year term, renewable once

b2b_relevance: LOW - Article 73 is purely about EDPB internal governance. No direct business obligations. The Chair represents the Board (Art 68(2)) and communicates Board activities to the Commission.
